audit.title: SpotAmp UX Audit — Phase 1
limitations: Fresh-install pairing, full touch ergonomics, offline recovery, and notification behavior were not measured.
TalkBack was enabled on retry, but spoken audio and gesture navigation were not independently verified; semantics-tree evidence was collected.
Only connected/paired browsing was exercised live.

findings.observation: Full-player play/pause is a clickable Box rather than an explicit button-semantic control.
evidence: NowPlayingScreenLayout.kt uses clickable Box for the primary control; BottomMiniPlayer.kt explicitly sets Role.Button and contentDescription.
findings.userImpact: Weaker TalkBack role/state communication and lower confidence during loading or paused states.
findings.recommendedDirection: Add explicit button role, label, and Playing/Paused/Loading state description.

findings.observation: Repeat exposes the generic label Repeat while visual state distinguishes modes.
evidence: NowPlayingScreenLayout.kt sets contentDescription to Repeat and changes the icon for Repeat One.
findings.userImpact: Users may not know whether Repeat is off, all, or one.
findings.recommendedDirection: Expose stateful labels/descriptions for Repeat Off, Repeat All, and Repeat One.

findings.observation: Reordering is long-press/drag based without a visible handle or alternate action.
evidence: NowPlayingScreenLayout.kt uses detectDragGesturesAfterLongPress on the queue row.
findings.userImpact: Reordering is hard to discover and may be unavailable to assistive-technology users.
findings.recommendedDirection: Add visible drag affordance and accessible move actions.

findings.observation: End-user settings and advanced backend diagnostics are presented together.
evidence: SettingsScreen.kt renders Device Readiness, Sync Diagnostics, page/prefix/signature fields, and a detailed event log.
findings.userImpact: The app may feel like server administration rather than a music player.
findings.recommendedDirection: Progressively disclose diagnostics behind an advanced/support section.

findings.observation: The offline-only switch is visually represented by an icon and switch without a visible text label.
evidence: SearchScreen.kt renders CloudDownload plus Switch; behavior filters to completed downloads.
findings.userImpact: Users may miss or misunderstand the filter.
findings.recommendedDirection: Add visible label and state description explaining downloaded-only search.

findings.observation: Grouped result previews are limited to three items and rely on a separate results route for more.
evidence: SearchScreen.kt uses take(3) for artist and album previews and has a results navigation callback.
findings.userImpact: Users may confuse preview omission with no result.
findings.recommendedDirection: Make See all/count affordances prominent and preserve query context.

findings.observation: Loading is a bare spinner and error/no-result branches are mostly bare text without a visible recovery action.
evidence: SearchScreen.kt branches to CircularProgressIndicator, searchError text, and No matches found text.
findings.userImpact: Users may not know whether to wait, retry, or change the query.
findings.recommendedDirection: Use labeled actionable states and preserve prior results during refresh where appropriate.

findings.observation: The entire mini-player row opens the full player, but there is no explicit expansion affordance.
evidence: BottomMiniPlayer.kt applies clickable to the parent column and renders metadata/play-pause only.
findings.userImpact: New users may miss the full player and may confuse the boundary with bottom navigation.
findings.recommendedDirection: Add Open Now Playing semantics and a subtle expansion cue.

findings.observation: Existing screenshot shows strong readability but substantial unused vertical space below queue content.
findings.userImpact: May feel under-composed on tall phones.
findings.recommendedDirection: Validate target aspect ratios before changing spacing.

findings.observation: Connected state is clear on live Home and Settings, but source/live review does not establish one consistent compact state distinguishing paired, reachable, reconnecting, and offline.
evidence: Live Home screenshot shows MUSIC BACKEND CONNECTED.
Live Settings screenshot shows SpotCore connected.
SettingsScreen.kt shows SpotCore connected; MainAppScreen.kt routes configured state but does not establish a persistent cross-screen status model.
findings.userImpact: Users may know when connected but still may not know what remains usable or how to recover after loss.
findings.recommendedDirection: Define plain-language connection states and actionable recovery affordances.

findings.observation: At system font_scale 1.3, Home backend status wraps to two lines and the Downloads bottom-navigation label wraps awkwardly; Search remains usable but bottom navigation becomes visually crowded.
findings.userImpact: Large-text users get weaker scanability and a less stable navigation bar.
findings.recommendedDirection: Use responsive label treatment or adaptive navigation for large text and validate the full player/detail surfaces at the same scale.

findings.screenWorkflow: TalkBack validation of player controls, queue, and Search filter
findings.observation: After TalkBack activation, the semantics tree exposed generic or incomplete interaction metadata: full-player Play is labeled but not itself clickable, Repeat is generic, and the Search switch is checkable with NAF=true and no label. Queue reorder has no accessible action path in source.
evidence: TalkBack detail confirmed switch On; live Search tree marked the switch NAF=true.
Now Playing tree exposed Play, Shuffle, Repeat, View Queue, but no accessible reorder action.
findings.userImpact: Screen-reader users may not be able to identify or activate core controls reliably.
findings.recommendedDirection: Expose each action as a labeled clickable control with current-state semantics; provide accessible queue move actions and a labeled offline switch.
